findings.status: Confirmed on original proposal; repaired before inert-tooling adoption
findings.root_cause: Frozen dataclass prevented attribute reassignment but retained mutable caller-owned nested containers; exporter reused nested origin/package references.
findings.evidence: Editing emitted text_origin.revision also edited the supposedly independent inspector reference; separate constructor and direct-nesting controls reproduced mutable manifest, payload and observation aliases.
findings.impact: Self-mutated origin/proof material could pass the proposed independent correspondence inspector. No v1 collection, staging, notice, legal or publishing bypass was demonstrated.
findings.fix: Recursively copy validated JSON containers into read-only mapping proxies/tuples and export detached ordinary JSON containers. Inspector comparison algorithm is unchanged.
findings.compatibility_and_risk: Only the newly proposed Python internal mappings become intentionally read-only; exporter remains plain dict/list JSON. No Kotlin/Rust/public library API change. This does not validate provenance or isolate against arbitrary malicious in-process code.

findings.root_cause: Per-package crate proof path was used as a dictionary key before canonical/type validation.
findings.evidence: List/dict paths raised raw TypeError. Synthetic null/integer/traversal/noncanonical controls also proved proof reads occurred before refusal in the original proposal.
findings.impact: Malformed material escaped the InvalidArtifact diagnostic contract or caused premature proof reads. No false successful collection or network/code execution was demonstrated.
findings.fix: Validate canonical path membership in the exact three-proof-name set before reading or using dictionary keys; retain exact set/cardinality and duplicate rejection.
